filesystem.description: Access datasets, analysis notebooks, model artifacts, and feature engineering pipelines

github.description: Version control analysis code and notebooks, collaborate on data science projects, track model iterations

postgres.description: Query databases for exploratory analysis, extract features, validate hypotheses with SQL analytics
postgres.notes: Update connection string with your database credentials

context7.description: Search statistical methodology docs, find ML best practices, access algorithm patterns and evaluation techniques

exploratory_analysis.description: Use Postgres MCP to query production databases for exploratory data analysis and feature extraction
exploratory_analysis.example: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) as purchase_count, AVG(order_value) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id

notebook_management.description: Use Filesystem MCP to read/write Jupyter notebooks, analysis scripts, and model artifacts
notebook_management.example: Read analysis.ipynb, update with new findings, save visualizations to results/

experiment_tracking.description: Use GitHub MCP to version control experiments, track model iterations, and collaborate on analyses
experiment_tracking.example: Commit model_v2.pkl with hyperparameters and performance metrics in commit message

methodology_lookup.description: Use Context7 MCP to find statistical methods, ML algorithms, and data science best practices
methodology_lookup.example: Search for 'random forest hyperparameter tuning' or 'time series cross-validation techniques'

configuration_notes.filesystem: Automatically configured with repository root. Use for accessing datasets, notebooks, and model artifacts.
configuration_notes.github: Set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in your environment or .env file. Requires repo scope for private repositories.
configuration_notes.postgres: Update connection string format: postgresql://user:password@host:port/database. Supports multiple database connections for different data sources.
configuration_notes.context7: Set CONTEXT7_API_KEY for documentation search. Sign up at context7.com for API access to data science documentation.
